subject: maths
title: Primary 1 Addition and Subtraction Within 100
seo_title: P1 Addition and Subtraction Within 100 Worksheets: Free Primary 1 Maths with Answers (MOE Syllabus)
standard_text: Adding and subtracting within 100, using algorithms; mental calculation with a 2-digit number and ones or tens
meta_desc: Free P1 maths practice: add and take away ones and tens, column addition and subtraction with renaming, and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Add ones to ones and tens to tens. Rename 10 ones as 1 ten.
key_sub: 36 + 27: 6 + 7 = 13, write 3 and rename 1 ten. 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 tens. Answer: 63.
body_html:
The idea: ones with ones, tens with tens

A 2-digit number has tens and ones. 43 is 4 tens and 3 ones. Add ones to ones. Add tens to tens.

Add in columns: rename 10 ones as 1 ten

Write ones under ones and tens under tens. Start with the ones. If the ones make 10 or more, rename 10 ones as 1 ten.

Subtract in columns: rename 1 ten as 10 ones

Take the bottom digit from the top digit. If the top digit is too small, rename 1 ten as 10 ones.

Word problems: use a number bond

Find the whole and the parts. If you know both parts, add. If you know the whole and one part, subtract.

Number bond

Mdm Wong has 72 oranges. She gives away 25. How many are left?

72 − 25. You cannot take 5 from 2, so rename 1 ten. 12 − 5 = 7. 6 − 2 = 4.

Answer: 47 oranges

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding ones to the tens: 43 + 5 = 935 is 5 ones. Add it to the ones: 48
Adding tens to the ones: 46 + 30 = 4930 is 3 tens. Add it to the tens: 76
Not renaming: 36 + 27 = 51313 ones is 1 ten and 3 ones. Answer: 63
Taking the smaller digit from the larger: 52 − 17 = 45You cannot take 7 from 2. Rename 1 ten: 12 − 7 = 5. Answer: 35

faq.q: What is taught in P1 addition and subtraction?
faq.a: Primary 1 pupils add and subtract within 100. They add or take away ones and tens in their heads, use the column method with renaming, and solve one-step word problems.

faq.q: How do I explain renaming to my child?
faq.a: Renaming means changing 10 ones for 1 ten, or 1 ten for 10 ones. Use bundles of 10 straws: when you have 13 loose straws, tie 10 of them into 1 bundle.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake in P1 addition and subtraction?
faq.a: Mixing up tens and ones is the most common mistake, such as 46 + 30 = 49. In subtraction, many children take the smaller digit from the larger one, so 52 − 17 becomes 45 instead of 35.

faq.q: Is addition and subtraction within 100 in the MOE syllabus?
faq.a: Yes. Adding and subtracting within 100, with the column method and mental calculation, is part of Number and Algebra in the MOE 2021 Primary 1 Mathematics Syllabus (Standard).
